literal_meaning: ডান দিকের শক্তিশালী বা সাহসী (right-sided strong or bold)
figurative_meaning_en: fearless and reckless, very restless, unruly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ডানপিটে মেয়ে, কখনো স্থির থাকে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a reckless girl who never stays still.
note: Refers to bold, mischievous individuals, often children, in colloquial Bengali usage.
